system.description:
Make an Interface Roll against all
adversaries within Far range.
Mark any number of Stress to wake
every compromised process, stolen
credential, old virus, hijacked device,
corrupted server, dead account, and
sleeper daemon you have seeded into
the local network.
Targets you succeed against take
1d20+2 physical damage for each
Stress marked.
On a success with Hope, choose one
affected target. They are also locked
out of all connected system, weapon
mode, drone link, cyberware feature, or
tactical support effect until their next
Spotlight.
